question: When did South Korea host the World Environment Day in 2025, as designated by the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 June**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Environment Day** is celebrated globally every year on **5 June**. This date was established by the **United Nations** to encourage worldwide awareness and action for the protection of the environment. ***Hence, option 4 is correct.***
 
• For the year **2025**, the **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)** designated the **Republic of Korea (South Korea)** as the global host for World Environment Day.
 
• The **2025** celebration in **South Korea** aims to highlight the urgency of ending **plastic pollution** and fostering global sustainability.
 
• The event is particularly significant as it precedes the potential conclusion of a global, legally binding instrument on **plastic pollution**, for which **South Korea** also hosted the fifth session of the **Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee (INC-5)**.
 
• The primary goal of **World Environment Day 2025** is to underscore the importance of a **circular economy** and the reduction of plastic waste on a global scale.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of World Environment Day:**
 
 
• It was established by the **UN General Assembly** in **1972** on the first day of the **Stockholm Conference on the Human Environment**.
 
• The first-ever World Environment Day was celebrated in **1973** with the theme "**Only One Earth**".
 
 
 
• **UN Environment Programme (UNEP):**
 
 
• **UNEP** is the leading global environmental authority that sets the global environmental agenda and promotes the coherent implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the **United Nations** system.
 
• The headquarters of **UNEP** is located in **Nairobi, Kenya**. It was founded by **Maurice Strong** in **June 1972**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Other Dates:**
 
 
• **22 April**: This date is celebrated as **Earth Day** (International Mother Earth Day), which focuses on broader environmental issues and climate literacy.
 
• **8 June**: This date is observed as **World Oceans Day**, dedicated to celebrating the role of the oceans in our everyday lives and inspiring action to protect them.
 
• **5 May**: While not the World Environment Day, **5 May** is occasionally associated with regional environmental observances or national days in various countries, such as **Children's Day** in **South Korea** and **Japan**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Recent Hosts and Themes:**
 
 
• **2024 Host**: **Saudi Arabia** hosted the event with a focus on **land restoration, desertification, and drought resilience**.
 
• **2023 Host**: **Côte d'Ivoire** (in partnership with the **Netherlands**) hosted the day with the theme "**Solutions to Plastic Pollution**".
 
• **2018 Host**: **India** hosted the global event with the theme "**Beat Plastic Pollution**", leading to a significant domestic commitment to ban single-use plastics.
 
 
 
• **Global Impact**: **World Environment Day** has grown to be the largest global platform for environmental public outreach, with millions of people from over **150 countries** participating in activities to protect the planet.
